description.sub_ename: DESIGN AND PRACTICE OF SMART MACHINE TOOL
description.describe_ch: 工具機產業市場競爭激烈，不僅需要在產品上力求創新與快速因應市場需求，因此工業4.0在工具機產品也是提高產品競爭力不可或缺的關鍵。所以這門課程主要目標是讓學生在工具機產品智慧製造實施方案，學習跨領域的技術，並養成及具備「智慧化」的基礎理論與技術能力，以達到落地實現「智慧工具機」的目標。
description.describe_eh: The machine tool industry faces intense market competition, requiring not only a focus on product innovation and rapid response to market demands but also the integration of Industry 4.0 principles into machine tool products to enhance competitiveness. Therefore, the primary objective of this course is to enable students to develop interdisciplinary skills in the implementation of smart manufacturing solutions for machine tool products. Students will learn the fundamental theories and technical capabilities of "smart" and work towards achieving the practical realization of "SMART Machine Tools".
